units: metres; plan x/y horizontal, z up; hours in game time

placement.algorithm: first nearest room bounding-box centre, then farthest from existing fixtures; reject outside polygon and floor voids

camera_policy.observation: daytime stylized sky reflection and sun highlights; night window emission; exterior shell
camera_policy.third_person: window emission off; near glass transparent, distant glass opaque and reflective
camera_policy.live: same as third_person; independent render pass
camera_policy.closed_wood_shutters: occlude interior naturally; never emit light

glass_lod.distance: 3D eye to module bounds centre, in metres
glass_lod.reflection: stylized sky Fresnel rim and directional sun highlight; no scene reflection capture
glass_lod.batching: separate cached clear and reflective model variants, split visible instance ranges
glass_lod.interiors: only nearby house footprints within clear radius plus 1 metre; keep existing house/light budget
